name: Hammerhead
role: Edge guard. Gives way to the Shark and the Manta.
habit: 2 waves in 3; 1 in 6 of those is a pair patrol on both seat rows. Takes the edge opposite the Shark.

routes.name: Rail patrol
routes.purpose: Patrols one seat row with a light weave. Also used for the pair patrol, mirrored on both rows.

routes.name: Corner turn
routes.purpose: Top row, then down a side.

routes.name: Head sweep
routes.purpose: Sways side to side along a row.

routes.name: Wide U
routes.purpose: In and out on the same side.

routes.name: Low arc
routes.purpose: Under the middle. Only when no Shark is on screen.

routes.name: Side swing
routes.purpose: A short visit to one side.
